bullets.text: Bharathiyar Nagar residents in Thiruvallur and Chennai are distressed as high sea waves have flooded homes, and the office should monitor relief efforts.
Authorities in ECR Thiruvanmiyur and Uthandi are using loudspeakers to warn people against approaching the violently surging sea, and the office should track safety compliance.
Cyclone Asna has caused tsunami-like high waves flooding Ennore Expressway, and the office should watch infrastructure safety in the affected zone.
Passengers fear a Chennai Airport shutdown as heavy rains loom and planned stormwater drain work drags on, so the office should track drainage progress.
PMK MLA Sowmya Anbumani urged the Tamil Nadu government to officially notify the Pallikaranai marshland, and the office should watch for department updates on this.
The Highways Department closed potholes on the Tambaram-Velachery Road using resin binder after complaints, and the office should watch slow pipe-laying work.
An ancient Nandi idol was damaged at the Somanathar temple, and the office should monitor police efforts to arrest the culprits.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay inspected the Chembarambakkam reservoir amid concerns over rainwater storage, and the office should track reservoir management updates.
Police arrested a driver and seized a lorry smuggling sand from Nagari, Andhra Pradesh through the Thiruttani Ponpadi check post, and the office should watch illegal transit.
Tata Communications plans to invest up to $450 million for a 10,000-kilometer India AI Super Highway, and the office should watch network expansion milestones.
IIIT-H and Ati Robotics demonstrated AI vision-based robot navigation using visual cues instead of LiDAR, and the office should track research application prospects.
MP Kanimozhi accused the TVK government of failing to control Aavin product prices, and the office should watch political reactions to this issue.
